findings.problem: The hint "one short word" doesn't rule out nach, which is also a common one-word way to say "according to" here ("Nach dem Wetterbericht regnet es"), and it doesn't rule out gemäß either.
findings.fix: hint: one short word, with no article after it here (not nach or gemäß)

back.target: according to (preposition, as in what a source says)
back.example: According to the weather report, it's going to rain tomorrow.

note: Laut Wetterbericht without an article is the natural everyday phrasing, so the example is a good model for learners.
